title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL
paper_type_zh: 多模态模型技术报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计部分共享声明、视觉语言训练配方与公开 checkpoint 边界的读者
one_line: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL discloses a five-stage multimodal SFT schedule, weights, an 8.15M-row dataset, and OCR tooling, but the public release is not reconciled with the 39.49M-sample inventory or exact stage lineage.
NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL 报告混合 Mamba-Transformer VLM、token reduction 和部分数据/配方/代码共享，但具体共享范围及反馈审计工件仍为 unknown。
why: It shows how to audit a frontier report by separating reported training consumption, model-card inventory, released artifacts, and evaluation evidence instead of treating a broad release statement or benchmark result as a complete data recipe.
inclusion_reason: This report is a useful frontier data-disclosure case because it pairs a five-stage multimodal SFT recipe with weights, a large but partial dataset release, and OCR tooling while leaving auditable gaps between reported consumption, inventory accounting, released rows, and exact lineage.

title: Problem
问题
html:
NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL addresses two linked problems. The modeling problem is to add image, document, video, and long-context abilities to a reasoning language backbone without permanently losing its text and code capabilities. The disclosure problem is to determine what the report actually makes reproducible: the consumed training mixture, released data, model weights, construction tooling, or only evaluation results.

The report documents a five-stage supervised fine-tuning schedule. Broad multimodal training initially damages text coding and long-context behavior; later code-only and long-context stages are introduced as capability-recovery steps. This makes dataset ordering and reuse part of the claimed method, not incidental implementation detail.

For audit, four ledgers must remain separate. The paper gives approximate per-stage sample and token consumption, including reuse. The model card describes a 39,486,703-sample, 270-dataset, 27.7 TB training inventory. Nemotron VLM Dataset V2 is an actual public artifact with 8,147,599 samples across 51 subdatasets. Benchmark tables evaluate model behavior. None of those four surfaces alone proves a complete, record-level data recipe.

NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2 VL 同时处理两个相关问题。模型层面，需要在推理语言骨干上增加图像、文档、视频和长上下文能力，同时避免永久损害文本与代码能力。披露层面，则要判断报告究竟使哪些对象可复现：训练时实际消费的数据混合、公开数据、模型权重、构造工具，还是仅有评测结果。

报告给出了五阶段监督微调流程。广泛的多模态训练最初削弱了文本编程和长上下文表现，后续再用纯代码阶段与长上下文阶段修复相应能力。因此，数据顺序与复用关系是方法的一部分，而不是无关紧要的实现细节。

审计时必须区分四本账。论文提供各阶段近似样本量和 token 消费量，其中包含跨阶段复用；模型卡记录 39,486,703 个样本、270 个数据集和 27.7 TB 的训练库存；Nemotron VLM Dataset V2 是实际公开工件，包含 51 个子数据集、8,147,599 个样本；基准表则测量模型行为。任何一本账都不能单独证明存在完整的记录级数据配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core training idea is staged multimodal SFT around a hybrid Mamba-Transformer language model. A c-RADIOv2-VLM-H vision encoder and MLP connector turn dynamically tiled images or sampled video frames into interleaved visual and text embeddings. Each tile yields 1,024 visual tokens before 2x pixel-shuffle reduction to 256; training allows up to 12 tiles plus a thumbnail, while each video frame uses one tile.

The curriculum separates alignment, broad capability acquisition, context extension, and capability repair. Stage 0 warms only the connector. Stage 1 unfreezes the full model and mixes text reasoning with broad image, OCR, document, grounding, safety, dialogue, tool-use, and function-calling data. Stage 2 extends context and emphasizes video and multi-image tasks. Stage 3 uses code-reasoning data to recover coding behavior. Stage 4 uses very long text examples to recover long-context behavior.

The data contract is supervised conversation prediction, not a reported reinforcement-learning reward. Answers and reasoning traces come from existing annotations, humans, named model families, rules, parsers, or programmatic generation. There is no universal verifier: the paper does not supply a common correctness test, acceptance threshold, or rejected-candidate ledger across all sources.

核心训练思路是在混合 Mamba-Transformer 语言模型周围组织分阶段多模态 SFT。c-RADIOv2-VLM-H 视觉编码器与 MLP 连接器把动态切片图像或抽样视频帧转成与文本交错的表示。每个切片最初产生 1,024 个视觉 token，经 2 倍 pixel shuffle 降至 256 个；训练时最多使用 12 个切片并附加一张缩略图，每个视频帧只使用一个切片。

课程把对齐、广泛能力获取、上下文扩展与能力修复分开。阶段 0 只预热连接器；阶段 1 解冻全部组件，混合文本推理、图像、OCR、文档、定位、安全、对话、工具使用和函数调用数据；阶段 2 扩展上下文并加强视频与多图任务；阶段 3 用代码推理数据修复编程表现；阶段 4 用超长文本样本修复长上下文表现。

这里的数据契约是监督式对话预测，而不是论文所披露的强化学习奖励。答案与推理轨迹来自现有标注、人工、具名模型家族、规则、解析器或程序化生成。不存在统一验证器：论文没有为所有来源给出共同的正确性测试、接收阈值或被拒候选账本。

title: Method
方法
html:
The five reported stages are:

  • Stage 0: about 2.2M multimodal samples and up to 36B tokens, drawn from Stage 1; the language model and vision encoder are frozen and only the connector is trained.
  • Stage 1: about 32.5M samples and 112.5B tokens at 16,384 tokens. It includes about 6.5M text-reasoning samples/40B tokens and 26M multimodal samples/about 72B tokens. Named domains include math, science, code, multilingual understanding, dialogue, tool use, safety, captioning, VQA, OCR, documents, grounding, and function calling.
  • Stage 2: about 11M samples and 55B tokens at 49,152 tokens. It reuses 25% of Stage 1 and adds about 1.4M video and multi-image samples/17B tokens. Non-QA sources are converted with templates or model-generated questions and answers. CommonCrawl PDFs are parsed with NeMo Retriever Parse for multi-page QA.
  • Stage 3: 1M code-reasoning samples/15B tokens at 49,152 tokens, introduced after coding scores declined.
  • Stage 4: about 74K long-context samples/12B tokens, averaging 160K tokens, trained with a 311,296-token maximum.

Reasoning traces are human-authored or generated with Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct, GLM-4.1V, and GLM-4.5V. Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 family models create QA from OCR or captions; selected Stage 2 datasets are relabeled with Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct. Exact prompts, revisions, candidate counts, filters, and acceptance rates are unknown.

Training uses Megatron, Transformer Engine, Megatron Energon, FP8 with selected layers retained in BF16, AdamW, cosine decay with warmup, online balance-aware sequence packing, and loss square-averaging. Videos are sampled at two frames per second up to 128 frames, or uniformly to 128 frames when longer than 64 seconds. The exact code/config revision for each run is not pinned.

The public dataset formats each item as an id plus multimodal messages. Content can reference text, images, video, or audio with optional source and media metadata. Some subsets include tarred media; others provide annotations and acquisition instructions. NVPDFTex separately compiles LaTeX into page PNGs and layout JSON with bounding boxes, category labels, and text, supplying synthetic OCR ground truth.

论文披露的五个阶段如下：

  • 阶段 0：约 220 万个多模态样本、最多 360 亿 token，数据取自阶段 1；冻结语言模型和视觉编码器，只训练连接器。
  • 阶段 1：在 16,384 token 上下文下训练约 3,250 万样本、1,125 亿 token。其中约 650 万文本推理样本占 400 亿 token，2,600 万多模态样本约占 720 亿 token。具名领域包括数学、科学、代码、多语言理解、对话、工具使用、安全、描述生成、VQA、OCR、文档、定位和函数调用。
  • 阶段 2：在 49,152 token 上下文下训练约 1,100 万样本、550 亿 token。它复用阶段 1 的 25%，并加入约 140 万视频与多图样本、170 亿 token。非问答来源通过模板或模型生成的问答转成 QA；CommonCrawl PDF 经 NeMo Retriever Parse 解析后构造多页问答。
  • 阶段 3：在 49,152 token 上下文下使用 100 万代码推理样本、150 亿 token，目的是修复此前下降的编程表现。
  • 阶段 4：使用约 7.4 万个长上下文样本、120 亿 token，平均长度 16 万 token，训练最大长度为 311,296。

推理轨迹由人工编写，或由 Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct、GLM-4.1V、GLM-4.5V 生成。Qwen2.5 与 Qwen3 家族从 OCR 文本或描述中生成问答；阶段 2 的部分数据由 Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct 重新标注。精确提示、模型修订、候选数量、过滤规则与接收率均为 unknown。

训练使用 Megatron、Transformer Engine 和 Megatron Energon；采用 FP8，并让部分层保留 BF16；优化器为 AdamW，配合线性预热与余弦退火，还使用在线均衡感知序列打包和 loss square-averaging。视频按每秒两帧采样，最多 128 帧；超过 64 秒时均匀抽取 128 帧。每次训练所对应的精确代码与配置修订没有固定下来。

公开数据把每条记录表示为 id 和多模态 messages。内容可引用文本、图像、视频或音频，并附带可选的来源及媒体元数据。部分子集在 tar 分片中包含媒体，另一些只给标注和获取上游媒体的说明。NVPDFTex 是另一条构造路径：它把 LaTeX 编译为页面 PNG 和含边界框、类别标签、文本的布局 JSON，用于生成 OCR 真值。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is artifact-level. NVIDIA publishes BF16 weights and separate FP8 and NVFP4-QAD checkpoints, Nemotron VLM Dataset V2, and NVPDFTex within NVIDIA-NeMo/Curator. The dataset card enumerates 51 released subdatasets and 8,147,599 samples, documents human-, Qwen-, GLM-, rule-, public-, and synthetic-processing tags, and explains when media is bundled versus separately acquired. This verifies a substantial release, but not the complete training mixture.

Three quantitative disclosures do not reconcile automatically:

  • The paper reports consumption by five stages, with deliberate reuse between stages.
  • The model card inventories 39,486,703 samples across 270 datasets and 27.7 TB: 24,544,290 public, 463,687 private, 368,946 crawled/scraped, and 14,109,780 self-sourced synthetic samples.
  • The public release contains 8,147,599 samples across 51 subdatasets. Its composition table totals 4,470.46 GB, while its quantification section reports 4,301.82 GB.

Stage ablations provide evidence for scheduling effects. LiveCodeBench falls from 70.0 before broad multimodal SFT to 50.9 after Stage 1, then returns to 69.8 after Stage 3; RULER falls from 77.9 to 8.8 and reaches 72.1 after Stage 4. Vision results remain mostly stable around the recovery stages. These measurements support the authors' motivation for capability-repair stages, but they do not validate individual labels, provenance, licensing, or decontamination.

Evaluation spans 45 multimodal benchmarks in seven categories plus text tasks, inference-budget experiments, EVS efficiency ablations, image-processing ablations, and quantization comparisons. They are behavior evidence under reported settings, not evidence that the released rows equal all training rows or that the data are correct.

最强证据来自实际工件。NVIDIA 发布了 BF16 权重、独立的 FP8 与 NVFP4-QAD 检查点、Nemotron VLM Dataset V2，以及 NVIDIA-NeMo/Curator 中的 NVPDFTex。数据集卡列出 51 个公开子集和 8,147,599 个样本，标记人工、Qwen、GLM、规则、公开来源和合成处理方式，并说明哪些子集附带媒体、哪些需要另行获取。这证明存在规模可观的公开发布，但不能证明完整训练混合已经公开。

三组数量披露不能自动对齐：

  • 论文按五个阶段报告训练消费量，并明确存在跨阶段复用。
  • 模型卡记录 39,486,703 个样本、270 个数据集和 27.7 TB，其中公开样本 24,544,290 个、私有样本 463,687 个、抓取样本 368,946 个、自建合成样本 14,109,780 个。
  • 公开数据集包含 51 个子集、8,147,599 个样本。其组成表合计 4,470.46 GB，但量化小节写的是 4,301.82 GB。

阶段消融为课程顺序的作用提供了证据。LiveCodeBench 从广泛多模态 SFT 前的 70.0 降至阶段 1 后的 50.9，阶段 3 后回到 69.8；RULER 从 77.9 降至 8.8，阶段 4 后达到 72.1；修复阶段前后视觉分数总体稳定。这些结果支持作者设置能力修复阶段的动机，但不能验证单条标注、来源、许可或去污染。

评测还覆盖七类共 45 个多模态基准、若干纯文本任务、推理预算实验、EVS 效率消融、图像处理消融和量化比较。它们是给定设置下的模型行为证据，不是“公开记录等于全部训练记录”或“数据必然正确”的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The most useful contribution for data curation is treating post-training order as a capability-management mechanism. The report does not present one static mixture: it shows broad multimodal acquisition causing measurable text regressions, followed by narrowly targeted code and long-context recovery stages. This makes stage membership, reuse, and order essential lineage fields for anyone attempting reproduction.

The release is also broader than a weights-only report. It includes a multimodal conversation dataset with 51 named subdatasets and processing tags, plus NVPDFTex for generating page images and structured OCR labels from LaTeX sources. The report connects document, video, reasoning, and long-context construction to a concrete architecture and training schedule.

Several components are not individually new: supervised fine-tuning, dynamic image tiling, model-generated labels, template-based QA conversion, multi-stage context extension, and post-training quantization are established techniques. The distinctive value is their integration and partial disclosure around a hybrid Mamba-Transformer VLM. “Large portions released” remains a partial-release statement until the report inventory, public files, and exact run manifests are reconciled.

对数据策展而言，最有价值的贡献是把后训练顺序视为能力管理机制。报告并非只给出一个静态混合：广泛多模态训练造成可测的文本能力退化，随后用目标明确的代码和长上下文阶段修复。因此，阶段归属、复用关系与顺序都是复现所需的核心血缘字段。

这也不是只有权重的发布。官方工件包括含 51 个具名子集及处理标签的多模态对话数据，以及可从 LaTeX 源生成页面图像和结构化 OCR 标注的 NVPDFTex。报告把文档、视频、推理和长上下文数据构造连接到具体架构与训练日程。

监督微调、动态图像切片、模型生成标注、模板式问答转换、多阶段上下文扩展和训练后量化本身都不是新技术。其独特价值在于围绕混合 Mamba-Transformer VLM 进行整合并提供部分披露。“已发布大部分内容”仍然只是部分发布声明，只有在报告库存、公开文件和精确训练清单得到对账后，才能视为完整配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Release accounting is incomplete. The five stage-consumption totals, 39.49M-sample model-card inventory, and 8.15M-sample public artifact use different units and scopes; no row-to-stage reconciliation is supplied.
  • The public dataset's composition table and quantification section disagree on total size: 4,470.46 GB versus 4,301.82 GB.
  • Internal, private, crawled, and nonredistributable OCR sources remain only partially described. A public generation tool cannot reconstruct unavailable inputs, labels, or selection decisions.
  • Some released subsets contain annotations without media. Users must retrieve upstream assets and audit their terms, revisions, and attribution obligations independently.
  • Collection-level CC BY 4.0 and the ten CC BY-SA 4.0 Wikimedia exceptions do not replace record-level rights lineage. Model weights have a separate NVIDIA Open Model License.
  • Human, model, rule, parser, and compiler labels are mixed. Exact generator revisions, prompts, candidate counts, correctness filters, thresholds, rejected outputs, and false-accept measurements are mostly unknown.
  • Corpus-wide deduplication and benchmark decontamination are unknown. The report does not publish benchmark revisions, match thresholds, matches, or removal ledgers.
  • The 2025-11-05 dataset update fixed a reasoning subset, malformed reasoning-tag entries, instructions, and indexes. Reproducible audits therefore require immutable revision pins and file checksums.
  • NVPDFTex lives on an experimental branch and documents a valid LaTeX table case that its rules fail to interpret; parser coverage is not universal.
  • The model card reports scanning image datasets against known CSAM, but this narrow check does not establish broader safety, privacy, consent, or rights review.
  • Multilingual training sources and benchmark results do not by themselves establish supported-language coverage for every modality or use case.
  • Benchmark gains, stage ablations, EVS throughput, and quantization comparisons evaluate model behavior; they cannot prove data provenance, label quality, or legal compatibility.

• 发布账本不完整。五阶段消费量、模型卡中的 3,949 万样本库存与 815 万样本公开工件在范围和计量方式上不同，也没有逐条对账。
  • 公开数据集的组成表与量化小节对总大小的记录不一致，分别为 4,470.46 GB 和 4,301.82 GB。
  • 内部、私有、抓取以及不可再分发的 OCR 来源只得到部分说明。公开生成工具不能还原不可获得的输入、标注或筛选决策。
  • 部分公开子集只有标注，没有媒体。使用者必须自行获取上游资源，并单独审计其条款、版本和署名义务。
  • 数据集合层面的 CC BY 4.0 和十个 Wikimedia 子集的 CC BY-SA 4.0 例外，不能替代记录级权利血缘；模型权重另受 NVIDIA Open Model License 约束。
  • 人工、模型、规则、解析器和编译器标注被混合使用。精确生成器版本、提示、候选数量、正确性过滤、阈值、被拒输出和误接收测量大多为 unknown。
  • 全语料去重和基准去污染为 unknown。报告没有发布基准修订、匹配阈值、命中记录或移除账本。
  • 2025-11-05 的数据更新修复了一个推理子集、异常推理标签、指令和索引，因此可复现审计必须固定不可变修订与文件校验和。
  • NVPDFTex 位于 experimental 分支，其文档展示了一个有效 LaTeX 表格仍无法被规则解释的案例，说明解析覆盖并不完整。
  • 模型卡称图像数据已对已知 CSAM 做扫描，但这项特定检查不能证明更广泛的安全、隐私、同意或权利审查已经完成。
  • 多语言训练来源与基准成绩不能单独证明所有模态和使用场景的语言支持范围。
  • 基准增益、阶段消融、EVS 吞吐和量化比较测量的是模型行为，不能证明数据来源、标注质量或法律兼容性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger track, this card is a concrete example of why “open” must be decomposed. An auditor can separately mark model weights, dataset rows, media availability, source terms, construction tools, training recipes, run configurations, verifier rules, and evaluation harnesses. Nemotron Nano V2 VL is strong on weights, a substantial public dataset, named stage totals, and OCR tooling; it is weaker on complete run manifests, record-level lineage, filtering decisions, and decontamination.

Data builders can reuse the released conversation schema, subdataset processing tags, Megatron Energon preparation, and NVPDFTex outputs. Researchers can study curriculum interference and recovery by treating stage order as an experimental variable. Document and video teams can inspect tiling, frame sampling, long-context packing, CommonCrawl PDF QA, and compiler-derived OCR as distinct construction paths rather than one homogeneous corpus.

A responsible downstream ledger should add immutable source revisions, per-record upstream identifiers, media terms, annotation generator and revision, transformation history, acceptance decisions, duplicate groups, benchmark-overlap decisions, stage membership, sampling weight, and file checksum. Without those fields, the public artifacts support adaptation and partial analysis but not exact replay of NVIDIA's training mixture.

对“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道而言，这张卡说明了为什么必须拆解“开放”。审计者应分别记录模型权重、数据行、媒体可得性、来源条款、构造工具、训练配方、运行配置、验证规则和评测工具。Nemotron Nano V2 VL 在权重、规模可观的公开数据、具名阶段总量与 OCR 工具方面披露较强，在完整运行清单、记录级血缘、过滤决策和去污染方面仍较弱。

数据构建者可以复用公开的对话结构、子集处理标签、Megatron Energon 准备方式和 NVPDFTex 输出。研究者可以把阶段顺序作为实验变量，研究课程干扰与能力恢复。文档和视频团队还可把动态图像切片、视频帧采样、长上下文打包、CommonCrawl PDF 问答以及编译器生成 OCR 视为不同构造路径，而不是一个同质语料库。

负责任的下游账本应补充不可变来源修订、逐条上游标识、媒体条款、标注生成器及其版本、转换历史、接收决策、重复组、基准重叠决策、阶段归属、采样权重和文件校验和。缺少这些字段时，公开工件足以支持适配和部分分析，但不足以精确重放 NVIDIA 的训练混合。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep four ledgers separate: five-stage paper consumption, 39.49M-sample model-card inventory, 8.15M-sample public release, and benchmark evaluation.
  • The report uses supervised fine-tuning throughout the five principal stages; it does not disclose a universal reward or verifier contract for the training rows.
  • Stage 1 adds broad multimodal capability but is associated with coding and long-context regressions; Stages 3 and 4 are targeted recovery stages.
  • Released labels combine existing annotations, humans, named model families, rules, parsers, and compiler-derived OCR ground truth. Generator revisions and acceptance details are incomplete.
  • The public dataset has 51 subdatasets, mixed media availability, a license exception for ten Wikimedia subsets, and an unresolved total-size discrepancy.
  • NVPDFTex is a real released pipeline, but its experimental status and documented parser failure make coverage limits auditable.

• 始终区分四本账：论文的五阶段消费量、模型卡的 3,949 万样本库存、815 万样本公开发布，以及基准评测。
  • 五个主要训练阶段均采用监督微调；报告没有为训练样本披露统一奖励或验证器契约。
  • 阶段 1 获得广泛多模态能力，但同时出现编程和长上下文退化；阶段 3 与阶段 4 是针对性的能力修复阶段。
  • 公开标注混合了现有标注、人工、具名模型家族、规则、解析器和编译器生成的 OCR 真值；生成器修订与接收细节并不完整。
  • 公开数据有 51 个子集，媒体可得性不同，十个 Wikimedia 子集采用许可例外，而且总大小存在尚未解释的不一致。
  • NVPDFTex 是真实公开的流水线，但 experimental 状态及文档中的解析失败案例使其覆盖边界可以被明确审计。

value.html: The report combines retained text-reasoning data from Nemotron Nano V2 with public, internal, private, crawled, and synthetic image, document, video, code, safety, function-calling, and long-context sources. Stage 1 names many upstream datasets; Stage 2 adds video, multi-image, and CommonCrawl PDF tasks. The released Nemotron VLM Dataset V2 exposes 51 subdatasets, but there is no record-level manifest mapping every released row to a training stage or to the unreleased mixture.

Released rows are multimodal conversations with an id and messages. Message content can contain text, image, video, or audio references and optional metadata such as dimensions, duration, frame count, page number, PDF, URL, or video identifier. Some subdatasets ship media in tar shards, while others ship JSONL annotations plus instructions for retrieving upstream media. Field presence varies by subset.

Human annotators and several model families supply labels or reasoning traces. The report names Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct, GLM-4.1V, and GLM-4.5V for reasoning traces, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 models for synthetic question-answer pairs, and Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct for selected Stage 2 relabeling. The release card labels rows as human-, Qwen-, GLM-, or rule-produced where applicable; a universal per-row generator revision is not disclosed.

items: optional PDF, page, URL, or video source field
license and media-included indicator at subdataset level

value.html: Offline multimodal supervised fine-tuning in Megatron with Megatron Energon loading, dynamic image tiling, sampled video frames, online sequence packing, and staged context extension from 16,384 to 311,296 training tokens.

No reinforcement-learning reward or universal correctness verifier is reported. Supervision is mixed: human labels, model-generated reasoning traces and question-answer pairs, rule-based conversions, existing source annotations, and synthetic OCR ground truth. Dataset-specific acceptance rules, judge prompts, thresholds, rejected candidates, and calibration results are mostly unknown.

No single terminal predicate is disclosed. A retained row may be an existing annotation, a template conversion, a model-generated question-answer pair or reasoning trace, a human annotation, or compiler-derived OCR ground truth. The exact per-subdataset completion and acceptance conditions are unknown unless documented by that subdataset.
Nemotron Nano V2, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer language model, combined with a c-RADIOv2-VLM-H vision encoder and an MLP connector.

Multiple label generators are named rather than one teacher. They include Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct, GLM-4.1V, GLM-4.5V, Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 family models, and Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct for selected relabeling. Exact checkpoints, prompts, and assignments for all rows are unknown.

The pipeline mixes source annotations, human annotation, model labeling, template conversion, and programmatic synthesis. NVPDFTex compiles LaTeX into page images plus bounding boxes, labels, and text for OCR ground truth. A separate CommonCrawl PDF workflow uses NeMo Retriever Parse extractions to create multi-page question-answer data.

Stage 0 uses a diverse 2.2M-sample subset of Stage 1. Stage 2 reuses 25 percent of Stage 1 and adds about 1.4M video and multi-image samples. Videos are sampled at two frames per second up to 128 frames, or uniformly to 128 frames when longer than 64 seconds. Other dataset weights, epoch counts, and row-level sampling decisions are unknown.
unknown
unknown

The model card reports filtering or fixing malformed reasoning-tag entries in the 2025-11-05 dataset update and scanning image datasets against known CSAM. It does not publish a complete corpus-wide quality filter, deduplication rule, reasoning-correctness check, acceptance threshold, or rejected-record ledger.

Training sequences progress from 16,384 tokens in Stages 0-1 to 49,152 in Stages 2-3 and 311,296 in Stage 4. Inference evaluation uses separate output budgets and is not part of the training-data contract. Aggregate construction-generation token cost is unknown.

Five stages use FP8 supervised fine-tuning with selected layers kept in BF16, AdamW, cosine annealing with linear warmup, online balance-aware sequence packing, and loss square-averaging. Stage 0 trains only the connector; all components are unfrozen thereafter. Context parallelism is 2-way in Stages 2-3 and 8-way in Stage 4. Some table values are not recoverable from the rendered report, and exact code/config revisions for every run are unknown.

The paper reports stage consumption of about 2.2M samples/36B tokens, 32.5M/112.5B, 11M/55B, 1M/15B, and 74K/12B, with deliberate reuse between stages. Separately, the model card inventories 39,486,703 samples across 270 datasets and 27.7 TB. The public Nemotron VLM Dataset V2 contains 8,147,599 samples across 51 subdatasets. These are different ledgers and are not reconciled by a row-to-stage manifest.

The model card labels the training inventory as 100 percent training with no training-inventory validation or test partition. The public release is organized by subdataset and exposes a train split for loading. No immutable manifest maps released rows, duplicates, reuse, ordering, epochs, or weights to Stages 0-4.

items: The paper's stage-consumption counts, the model card's 39,486,703-sample inventory, and the 8,147,599-sample public release are not interchangeable and lack a reconciliation manifest.
The release card's composition table totals 4,470.46 GB while its quantification section reports 4,301.82 GB.
A large part of the OCR mixture cannot be redistributed; releasing NVPDFTex enables regeneration for compatible LaTeX sources but does not recreate every withheld source or transformation.
NVPDFTex is on an experimental branch and its documented rules do not cover every valid LaTeX page structure.
Model-produced reasoning traces and question-answer labels can contain plausible but incorrect intermediate steps; no universal trace verifier or false-accept audit is disclosed.
Corpus-wide deduplication, benchmark decontamination, thresholds, matched-record ledgers, and removals are unknown.
Some released annotations depend on separately acquired media and upstream terms, so the collection-level license does not by itself establish a complete rights chain.
The dataset was updated to repair malformed reasoning-tag entries and instructions, showing that revision pinning matters for audit and reproduction.
Image-data scanning against known CSAM is a specific safety check, not evidence of comprehensive safety, privacy, or rights review.
Benchmark scores and stage ablations measure model behavior under stated evaluation settings; they do not prove record-level provenance, label correctness, license compatibility, or data quality.

value.html: The public dataset collection is labeled CC BY 4.0 except ten Wikimedia subsets labeled CC BY-SA 4.0. Media is redistributed only for subsets whose terms allow it; other subsets provide annotations and acquisition instructions. The model weights use the NVIDIA Open Model License. Upstream media rights, attribution duties, and model-generated-label terms still require subset- and use-specific review.

Upstream public, internal, private, crawled, or synthetic source -> existing, human, model, rule, parser, or compiler annotation -> multimodal conversation formatting -> stage-specific mixture and context schedule -> BF16 model -> FP8 post-training quantization or NVFP4 quantization-aware distillation. The public release provides useful subset tags, but record-level generator revisions, rejected candidates, exact stage membership, and full unreleased-source lineage remain incomplete.
